name: lunaut
description: Luau language server written in C++: FFlags, prioritized .d.luau definitions and Rojo support

lunaut.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `lunaut` executable. Empty uses the bundled server, then `lunaut` from `PATH`.

lunaut.platform.markdownDescription: `auto` turns on Roblox mode when a Rojo project or sourcemap is found.

lunaut.fflags.sync.markdownDescription: Sync FFlag values with the current Roblox Studio build.

lunaut.fflags.enableNewSolver.markdownDescription: Turn on the new Luau type solver (`LuauSolverV2`).

lunaut.fflags.override.markdownDescription: FFlag values that win over everything else, for example `{ "LuauTypeInferIterationLimit": "4000" }`.

lunaut.definitions.markdownDescription: Definition files (`.d.luau`). Globs are allowed. Higher `priority` loads first.

lunaut.discoverDefinitions.markdownDescription: Load every `*.d.luau` found in the workspace.

lunaut.roblox.downloadTypes.markdownDescription: Download the Roblox API definitions in Roblox mode.

lunaut.roblox.securityLevel.markdownDescription: Security level of the downloaded Roblox API definitions.

lunaut.roblox.typesPriority.markdownDescription: Load priority of the downloaded Roblox definitions.

lunaut.rojo.enabled.markdownDescription: Use the Rojo sourcemap for requires and instance types.

lunaut.rojo.autogenerate.markdownDescription: Run `rojo sourcemap` when files are added, removed or the project changes.

lunaut.rojo.strictDatamodelTypes.markdownDescription: Type `game`, `script` and `workspace` from the sourcemap in diagnostics too.

lunaut.baseLuaurc.markdownDescription: A `.luaurc` applied under every other one: shared aliases and lint settings. Relative to the workspace, `~/` allowed.

lunaut.inlayHints.variableTypes.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type after local variables and loop variables.

enumDescriptions: Only before literal arguments like `5` or `"text"`
lunaut.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter names before call arguments.

lunaut.inlayHints.parameterTypes.markdownDescription: Show the inferred type of function parameters without annotations.

lunaut.inlayHints.functionReturnTypes.markdownDescription: Show the inferred return type of functions without a return annotation.

lunaut.inlayHints.hideHintsForErrorTypes.markdownDescription: Do not show hints for types that failed to infer.

lunaut.inlayHints.hideHintsForMatchingPa.markdownDescription: Do not show a parameter name when the argument already has that name.

lunaut.inlayHints.makeInsertable.markdownDescription: Double-clicking a type hint inserts it as an annotation.

lunaut.hover.documentation.markdownDescription: Show documentation in hover and completion: Roblox and Luau API docs and comments above declarations. Downloads the API docs once a day.

lunaut.documentationFiles.markdownDescription: Extra documentation files in the Roblox API docs JSON format.

lunaut.disabledGlobals.markdownDescription: Globals to remove: whole libraries like `table` or members like `table.clone`.

lunaut.completion.autoImports.markdownDescription: Suggest modules and Roblox services that are not required yet and add the `require` or `GetService` line.

lunaut.semanticTokens.enabled.markdownDescription: Color locals, parameters, globals, properties, methods and types by meaning.

lunaut.colors.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a color picker for `Color3.new`, `fromRGB`, `fromHSV` and `fromHex`.

lunaut.completion.autocompleteEnd.markdownDescription: Add `end` (or `until`) after pressing Enter on `function`, `if ... then`, `do`, `repeat` and friends; adds a missing `then` or `do` too.

lunaut.format.convertQuotes.markdownDescription: Typing `{` inside a `"string"` turns it into an interpolated `` `string` ``. Needs `editor.formatOnType`, which the extension turns on for Luau.

lunaut.format.enabled.markdownDescription: Format documents and selections with StyLua.

lunaut.diagnostics.workspace.markdownDescription: Show diagnostics for every file in the workspace, not only open ones.

lunaut.analyzer.path.markdownDescription: Shared library with a custom Luau analyzer. Setting a path turns `lunaut.analyzer.enabled` on.

lunaut.analyzer.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Merge diagnostics returned by the analyzer plugin with the built-in ones.

lunaut.rojo.watch.markdownDescription: Keep `rojo sourcemap --watch` running while VS Code is open, instead of regenerating the sourcemap on every change.

lunaut.studioPlugin.enabled.markdownDescription: Listen for the Roblox Studio companion plugin, which sends the live DataModel. Works with the luau-lsp Studio plugin.

lunaut.studioPlugin.port.markdownDescription: Port for the Studio companion plugin.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle-server && vsce package --out lunaut.vsix
